mapper.select: SELECT b.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, b.address, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, b.lat, b.lng, (6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{currentLat})) * COS(RADIANS(b.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b.lng) - RADIANS(#{currentLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{currentLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(b.lat)) )) AS distance FROM branch b JOIN branch_stock bs ON b.branch_code = bs.branch_code WHERE b.branch_code != #{currentBranchCode} AND bs.material_code = #{materialCode} AND bs.current_qty >= #{requiredQty} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' HAVING distance <= #{distance} ORDER BY distance;
SELECT lat, lng FROM branch WHERE branch_code = #{branchCode}
SELECT material_group_id as materialGroupId, group_name as groupName FROM material_group ORDER BY material_group_id;
